div.head: Hu 4
div.ab: And we cwǽdon be uncuðum ýrfe, þæt nan man næfde, buton hé hæbbe ðæs hundredesmanna gewitnyssa oððe ðæs teoðingmannes, ⁊ se sy wel getrýwe.
Et diximus de ignotis pecoribus, ut nemo habeat sine testimonio hominis hundredi uel hominum decime (decimalium), et hoc sit bene credibile.
Diximus etiam de ignoto pecore, ne quis illud habeat absque testimonio concionatoris uel decimationarii, et hic sit fidelissimus.
And we cwǽdon be uncuðum yrfe, þæt nan man næfde, buton hé hæbbe ðæs hundredesmanna gewitnyssa oððe ðæs teoðingmannes, ⁊ se sy wel getrýwe.

Und wir bestimmten über Vieh unbekannter [Herkunft], dass niemand [solches] halte, es sei denn, er habe [für den Erwerb] die Zeugenschaft(en?) des Hundertvorstehers oder des Zehntschaftvorstehers, und dieser sei recht vertrauenswerth.

And we determined concerning cattle of unknown [origin] that no one keep [such], unless he has the witness(es?) [for its acquisition] of the hundred-man or of the tithing-man, and that this man be thoroughly trustworthy.

And with regard to strange cattle, we have declared that no-one shall keep any such, except with the cognisance of the men of the hundred or with that of the chief official of the tithing; and he must be a thoroughly trustworthy man.

And we decreed concerning strange cattle, that no one was to keep any, unless he have the witness of the man in charge of the hundred or of the man over the tithing; and he [the witness] is to be very trustworthy.
div.note: B's ‘hundredesmanna’ should be corrected to ‘-mannes’ (Quadr., Cons.). Liebermann compares Hu 5.

Beim Oberen des Hundred oder der Zehnerschaft muss neu erworbene Fahrhabe polizeilich angemeldet werden, bevor Gewährzug freisteht; s. Gl Kaufzeugen 7; Hundred 25d. e. f.—Gegen Hermann Mobiliarvindikation 151 gewährleistet þæs und der Singular in Q Cons die Emendation{**} in B.—Vgl. o. III Em 5{a}

Newly acquired chattels must be officially registered with the head of the hundred or of the tithing before vouching to warranty is permitted; see Gl Kaufzeugen 7; Hundred 25d. e. f.—Against Hermann Mobiliarvindikation 151, þæs and the singular in Q Cons guarantee the emendation{**} in B.—Cf. above III Em 5{a}
Q irrt wie o. 2⁴ und übersetzt den Singular in Plural
Q errs as above 2⁴ and translates the singular as a plural
Q bezieht das Masc. se irrig auf das Fem. gewitnes. Die Regierung mahnt, zum Lokalvorsteher nur einen Ehrenmann zu nehmen
Q wrongly refers the masc. se to the fem. gewitnes. The government urges that only a man of honour be taken as local headman

Schmid and Liebermann suggest that mannes should be read for manna, especially as Q has hominis hundredi. The reference would then be to the chief official of the hundred, otherwise the twelve men gecorene to gewitnesse mentioned in IV Edg. 5 may possibly be meant.
